verdict.rationale: AWS's Bedrock AgentCore docs explicitly describe agents calling MCP servers as tools alongside APIs and Lambda functions, with AgentCore handling the auth/access control for those connections — showing AWS-built agents can plug in and use MCP server tools. However, this is a single high-level mention rather than detailed first-party documentation on configuring/registering MCP servers, and there's no independent hands-on corroboration of the workflow. Missing for 10: detailed setup/config docs for attaching MCP servers to an agent, and independent/community confirmation of the integration working in practice.
